Initial release of AI Song Generator.

- Generate original songs from text or lyrics with fast, cloud-based processing.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, MP3, WAV files up to 200MB; outputs 1080p MP4 within minutes.
- Simple setup: automatic connection and session management, including free trial tokens for new users.
- Built-in commands for uploading, export, checking credits, and monitoring status.
- Clear feedback and error messages throughout the workflow.
- Designed for content creators, musicians, and marketers to easily turn text or lyrics into music and video.
